caption_L1: This bar diagram is named Distribution of coronavirus cases in Italy as of December 29 , 2020 , by age group. The x-axis shows Response with categorical scale with 0-9 years on one end and 90 years or older at the other while the y-axis measures Share of infected individuals over total cases using scale of range 0.00 to 0.15.
caption_L2L3: The highest number of cases with coronavirus in Italy is in the 50 to 59 age group, followed by the 40 to 49 years age group.
